notes: SDSS J090745.0+024507: The paper-local shorthand “HVS” is recorded from T:p1-b7. The paper frames it as the recently discovered HVS from Brown et al. (T:p1-b4) whose velocity exceeds the Galactic escape speed (T:p1-b7), so it is treated as a follow-up. The “HVS2” in T:p5-b5 is explicitly hypothetical and is not included.

SDSS J090745.0+024507: T:p1-b7 also reports v_los = 848 km/s after correction for solar motion relative to the LSR; it is omitted because radial_velocity excludes LSR-relative velocities. T:p1-b7 gives Galactic coordinates and the SDSS designation but no explicit equatorial RA/Dec, so no ra/dec values are extracted.
